properties.notes: Demolition of existing buildings at health facility and erection of 89 dwellings approved and now under-construction (16/02336/FUL). Completion by 2020/21 is anticipated. Site is a mix of brownfield and greenfield land. Brownfield parcel (3.12ha) represents around 30% of the site area but the new development is limited to the footprint of the former buildings. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 3034) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 10.93ha.
